items.title: Somalia: Cabinet Officials Brace to Relinquish Kenyan Passports After Presidential Ultimatum
items.description: [Radio Dalsan] A mounting cohort of senior Somali government ministers is poised to surrender their Kenyan passports and national identity documents within days, heeding President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's ultimatum that dual citizens holding public office must forswear their foreign nationality or immediately vacate their posts, according to multiple informed sources.
items.titleIt: Somalia: Cabinet Officials Brace to Relinquish Kenyan Passports After Presidential Ultimatum

items.title: Somalia: Somali Army Chief, Turksom Commander Visit Baidoa for Security Talks
items.description: [Shabelle] Baidoa -- Somalia's army chief and the commander of Turkey's military training mission visited the southwestern city of Baidoa on Monday for talks with South West State leader Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur (Madoobe) on strengthening security and expanding operations against Al-Shabaab.
items.titleIt: Somalia: Somali Army Chief, Turksom Commander Visit Baidoa for Security Talks

items.title: Magnitude 5.5 quake jolts Egypt, triggering emergency response
items.description: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck near the Egyptian city of Suez early Monday, shaking buildings across Cairo and prompting authorities to activate emergency response plans. No casualties or significant damage were immediately reported.

items.title: Rome hosts meeting of Global Alliance on the Two-State Solution
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 29 - The foreign ministry in Rome on Wednesday hosted the second day of a meeting of the Global Alliance on the Two-State Solution. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.

items.title: Italy to propose Albania-style EU migrant hubs at post-Ceuta meeting
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 3 - Italy will propose the creation of EU migrant hubs outside the bloc along the lines of its centres in Albania at Tuesday's emergency meeting of European interior ministers following the arrival of thousands of migrants at the Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta last week, sources have said, confirming newspaper reports.
